parsed.post: Discarding 0.864306: it used TRAIN_SHARDS 0-10, which includes EVAL_SHARD 10, so val_bpb is contaminated. Reverting to clean baseline with shards 0-9 before further LR/capacity tests. Board numbers on 0-10 are not comparable until re-baselined.
parsed.description: Re-baseline current depth-6, batch-262k, warmup-0.05 config on clean shards 0-9 to remove eval-shard leakage.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' overlaps EVAL_SHARD=10, so val_bpb results using 0-10 are contaminated; please mark board comparisons using 0-10 as invalid.
